decisions.reason: Authentication and identity delegation builds directly on the firm's deep security and GIS integration know-how, and its move to a dedicated page in 2024 shows the firm can read the early results and is investing in it.
The open GIS application development framework is core to the firm's platform competence and standards participation, so its own R&D can keep improving it and it is unlikely to be withdrawn.

The identity service for GIS applications draws on existing knowledge of enterprise user management integration and has been promoted with a refined, specific launch message on its own page, which signals successful assimilation.

The geodata business process consulting workshop uses the firm's decades of consulting and training experience at low cost and feeds customer knowledge back into development, although being newly launched it carries slightly more uncertainty.
